ghi_chu: CHỌN: bản gốc G1 đọc rút gọn "I'm spent" (âm vị aɪ m s p ɛ n t; M+S "I'm") — trái nguyên văn Pepys "I am spent"; bản thu lại M+S "I am spent."

khoa: Nineteen years earlier, the engraver Wenceslaus Hollar had published a long view of this skyline, drawn from St Saviour's church, just along the bank: a forest of church towers, and above them all, the long roof of Old St Paul's.
